project.title: OWN7 NFL line origination lab
project.subtitle: Week 10 of the 2026 NFL season: official-source injury and depth tracking, a documented line-origination model, a fail-closed validation protocol and a competition that cannot yet be entered.
project.status: Research and decision support only. No market price is published, no strategy is qualified and no reward is paid.
project.data_scope: 28 of 32 clubs play in the Week 10 slate. Injury rows are limited to players named in the official NFL.com Wednesday roundup plus every player carrying a game designation on the NFL.com injury page; practice-only rows that appear on the injury page but nowhere else are not republished. Club depth charts were read for three clubs (Arizona, Cleveland, San Francisco) and no other.
project.rights: NFL.com Terms and Conditions section 1.3 permits individual, non-commercial, informational use only and prohibits systematic retrieval or compilation. This is a small, dated, attributed teaching sample - not a data product - and the restriction is a blocking gate, not a formality.
project.disclaimer: Not betting advice, not a licensed data product, not legal advice. Blank cells are unverified values and are never inferred. Model numbers are derived outputs of the stated parameters, not market lines.

strategies.name: Standings power rating
strategies.hypothesis: A multiplicative offence/defence rating built only from official points for and against, shrunk toward the league mean, plus a fixed home-field term, produces a spread and total that can be compared with a market price.
strategies.signal: model_home_margin and model_total on the model page, each with a sensitivity band
strategies.verified_today: 32 club rows with two arithmetic identities passing on every row
strategies.missing: Closing market prices, a settled-outcome history and a pre-game information archive

strategies.name: Pythagorean regression fade
strategies.hypothesis: Clubs whose actual win percentage runs ahead of their points-based expectation are more likely to regress than their record implies.
strategies.signal: actual win percentage minus Pythagorean expectation (exponent 2.37, a documented design choice)
strategies.verified_today: The diagnostic correlates 0.877 with actual win percentage (n=32) - which is why it is a diagnostic, not an edge
strategies.missing: Out-of-sample seasons, prices, and an independent sample that is not the data used to fit the exponent

strategies.name: Home-field control model
strategies.hypothesis: League-average scoring plus a fixed home-field term is the null model every candidate must beat.
strategies.signal: league average of 23.0104 points per team-game plus the home-field parameter
strategies.verified_today: league average computed from all 32 official rows and checked by the league-wide PF = PA identity
strategies.missing: It is a control, not a claim. It cannot win; it exists so a candidate that does not beat it is rejected.

strategies.name: Injury-adjusted rating
strategies.hypothesis: Rating points can be removed from a club when a first-string player does not practise, weighted by position and by the quality of the listed replacement.
strategies.signal: practice status joined to club depth-chart order
strategies.verified_today: 208 injury rows and 36 depth rows across three clubs, each with two official sources
strategies.missing: Position weights, replacement-quality estimates and depth coverage beyond 3 of 28 clubs

strategies.name: Depth-deficiency fade
strategies.hypothesis: A defence whose depth chart lists no replacement behind an unavailable first-string player is more vulnerable than one that simply lists an injured starter.
strategies.signal: the 'no backup listed' rows on the depth page (for example San Francisco left corner and nickel, Cleveland WILL)
strategies.verified_today: Five first-string players this week have no second string listed on their club chart
strategies.missing: A historical record of how such gaps actually performed, and any price to trade them

strategies.name: Same-game parlay: model spread + model total
strategies.hypothesis: Two legs taken from the same game can be priced jointly if the correlation between them is estimated rather than assumed to be zero.
strategies.signal: joint distribution of margin and total implied by the ratings
strategies.verified_today: Nothing at leg level: the model gives margins around a mean, not a joint distribution
strategies.missing: Settled leg-level outcomes (margin and total together) to estimate the correlation, plus prices for both legs

strategies.name: Cross-game two-leg parlay
strategies.hypothesis: Legs from different games can be treated as independent only after checking that no shared factor (common opponent, travel, weather, referee) links them.
strategies.signal: product of the two leg probabilities, adjusted only if a measured correlation is non-zero
strategies.verified_today: The independence assumption is stated explicitly; no correlation is measured
strategies.missing: Leg-level joint outcomes and prices, plus a shared-factor screen

strategies.name: Player prop combo: quarterback passing yards + team total
strategies.hypothesis: A backup quarterback start changes both the passing-yards distribution and the team total, and the two legs are strongly correlated, so a combo must be priced jointly.
strategies.signal: announced starter change (Arizona, Cleveland, Miami) joined to the club depth chart
strategies.verified_today: Three announced quarterback changes with official sources, and the depth order behind each
strategies.missing: Official player game logs, prop prices, and settled prop results

gates.name: Every input is an official source
gates.requirement: Each number used in a price, probability or score traces to an official publisher, with a check date and the exact scope read.
gates.evidence_today: Ratings, standings, injuries and depth rows pass. There is no official price input, so price-based strategies cannot pass.

gates.name: Pre-game timestamp, no lookahead
gates.requirement: Each input carries the timestamp at which it was true, and nothing published after the bet could have been placed is used.
gates.evidence_today: The Wednesday practice report is verified, but the Sunday Game Status Report is due Friday 4 p.m. New York time and does not exist yet. Publishing a Sunday price from Wednesday data would be stale by rule.

gates.name: Minimum independent sample
gates.requirement: At least 100 independent settled observations for any claimed relationship, before any ranking or prize.
gates.evidence_today: 32 team rows and 14 upcoming games. n = 32 is a description of one season, not a sample of outcomes.

gates.name: Market price benchmark
gates.requirement: A timestamped, licensed closing price for the exact market and leg being modelled.
gates.evidence_today: No official NFL price publication was located; https://www.nfl.com/odds/ returned 404 on 2026-11-12. Market columns are blank.

gates.name: De-vigged fair price
gates.requirement: The bookmaker margin is removed with a stated method before any edge is computed.
gates.evidence_today: Cannot be computed without prices. Left blank rather than assumed.

gates.name: Calibration and proper scoring
gates.requirement: Brier score and log loss against the control model, with a reliability check, on data that was not used to build the model.
gates.evidence_today: Specified; no out-of-sample run exists. Method reference registered.

gates.name: Skill separated from luck
gates.requirement: A pre-registered test (permutation or circular block bootstrap) with a stated effect size and a confidence interval on both score and return.
gates.evidence_today: No settled results, so no test. Luck cannot be removed from a 14-game sample by arithmetic.

gates.name: Multiple-testing control
gates.requirement: Every tested variant is counted and Holm-adjusted; the family is declared before testing.
gates.evidence_today: The mechanism is specified. Nothing has been tested, so nothing has been adjusted. Eight strategy families are already declared, which sets the size of the family.

gates.name: Correlation-aware parlay valuation
gates.requirement: Joint probability for every leg combination, estimated from leg-level outcomes, never from the product of single-leg probabilities.
gates.evidence_today: Team-level correlations are published (see the correlation page) but they are not leg correlations. Leg-level values are blank.

gates.name: Source rights and legal clearance
gates.requirement: Documented permission for the intended use, or a use that clearly falls inside the publisher's permitted individual non-commercial use.
gates.evidence_today: NFL.com Terms section 1.3 permits individual non-commercial informational use only and prohibits systematic retrieval and compilation. No licence is evidenced. Cash rewards and any gambling-linked use are not cleared.

leaderboard.why_empty: No strategy has passed the gates. Ranking blocked strategies would manufacture a winner out of luck.
leaderboard.scoring: Brier skill score against the control model (ST-03), reported with a circular block-bootstrap confidence interval. Log loss as a secondary score. A candidate is only ranked once the sample gate and the skill gate both pass.
leaderboard.ranking_rule: Ranks are assigned only among candidates that pass every gate, and only after Holm adjustment across the declared family of eight strategies.
leaderboard.reward_rule: Non-monetary merit points only. Points have no cash value, cannot be transferred and are not paid for betting. Cash or prizes tied to betting performance are blocked by G10 and by the unreviewed legal and regulatory position.

correlation_method.computed_today: Five team-level Pearson and Spearman correlations with Fisher 95% intervals, from the 32 official standings rows (n=32).
correlation_method.not_computed: Leg-level correlations for spreads, totals and player props. These require settled leg-level outcomes (margin and total observed together) and prices for the exact legs; neither exists here.
correlation_method.blank_policy: The leg-level cells are left blank and flagged rather than filled with an assumed value. Assuming zero correlation for same-game legs is the specific error G9 exists to prevent.
